lang: python

---
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class VeraPDFResult:
    returncode: int
    summary: str


def run_verapdf_check(verapdf_bin: str, flavour: str, pdf: str) -> VeraPDFResult:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [verapdf_bin, "-f", flavour, "--format", "json", "--loglevel", "0", pdf],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )
    return VeraPDFResult(returncode=proc.returncode, summary=proc.stdout[:200])
